name: Rick and Carl
look: Two stacked stills from The Walking Dead in front of a brick wall painted "C BLOCK". Top: Carl, a boy in a brown cowboy hat, looks down while his dad Rick, scruffy in a dirty white shirt, talks to him from the right. Bottom: Rick leans in closer with a pleading, teary face.
use: Rick tells Carl a terrible pun or dad joke as if it were a heartfelt talk. In the bottom panel he delivers the punchline or pushes on, desperate for a reaction, while Carl stays silent and unamused.
slots: bottom: Rick's pun or desperate follow-up
examples: Carl, why can't you trust stairs?
They're always up to something, Carl
Carl, I'm reading a book about anti-gravity
It's impossible to put down, Carl
